decisions.reason: The accepted pagination process makes finalization of the book's trim size a prerequisite for adding the Table of Contents page numbers.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: We can add the page numbers after the book size has been fixed.

value_updates.trim_size_finalization_timing: Fix the book size before adding the Table of Contents page numbers.

decisions.reason: The timing of pagination after book-size finalization does not change Chapter 18 heading typography.
The source changes only the timing of adding page numbers and does not alter chapter-image coverage or placement.
The source does not change image aspect-ratio preservation, cropping, or rendering dimensions.
Pagination timing has no effect on the copyright-page publication attribution.
The source does not affect the approved title text or its exclusion of the unintended newline marker.
The page-number timing decision does not change image sources, suitability review, or suitability criteria.
The source does not resolve or modify the cover's image count, text treatment, or existing design ambiguity.
The pagination dependency does not alter any approved manuscript passages, tracked edits, or table punctuation.
The source does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
